clue.text: Battleship inspiring fear and love?

parts.note: dread is a synonym of fear
in tennis scoring love means zero, a nought

explanation.surface: A warship that strikes terror and affection in equal measure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Love' is the tennis score of nothing; 'inspiring' just links the battleship to its fearsome name.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dreadnought was a famous class of big-gun warship, so the name stands for any such battleship.

clue.text: Put up a bed, and board? That's open to negotiation

indicators.note: in a down clue, putting a word up means writing it from the bottom, so it reads backwards

parts.note: a table is a board, as in 'board and lodging'

explanation.surface: Someone assembles a bed and a board, and asks whether that is up for discussion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put up' only works because this is a down clue: the bed reads upwards. 'board' means a table, as in 'board and lodging'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something debatable is arguable, still a matter for discussion rather than settled.

clue.text: Oriental festival has name

parts.note: Easter is the Christian spring festival

explanation.surface: A festival from the Orient bears a name.
explanation.definitionFit: Oriental and eastern both describe things from the East.

clue.text: Girl, it's clear to see, may be cut up

parts.note: Di is a short girl's name, as for Diana
visible means plain to see

explanation.surface: A girl remarks, quite plainly, that something can be chopped up.
explanation.definitionFit: Divisible describes whatever can be split into parts, which is to say it may be cut up.

clue.text: Stares lasciviously at leg so shaken

indicators.note: shaken suggests the letters of leg so are jumbled into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone eyes a leg so lecherously that it is shaken.
explanation.definitionFit: To ogle is to look at someone with obvious desire, a lustful stare.

clue.text: Non Jew is kind to take one in

indicators.note: take ... in tells us one word swallows another, here the gentle word around the one
completes the phrase take one in, signalling the insertion

parts.note: gentle means kind
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A non-Jew is generous enough to take a stranger in.
explanation.definitionFit: A gentile is a person who is not Jewish.

clue.text: River runs through part of the camp?

indicators.note: runs through means the letter for runs passes into the middle of the tent word

parts.note: a tent is one unit of a camp
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A river flows right through a section of the campsite.
explanation.definitionFit: The Trent is a major river of the English Midlands.

clue.text: Considerably increases lumps of ice

definitions.meaning: to cube a number is to raise it to the third power, a large increase

explanation.definitionFit: Cubing multiplies a quantity by itself twice, and ice in drinks comes as cube-shaped blocks.

clue.text: Seceding, has resolved to do this?

definitions.text: Seceding, has resolved to do this?

indicators.note: resolved here means worked out afresh, so the letters of seceding and has are reorganised

explanation.surface: Someone breaking away from a group has decided to defect.
explanation.walkthrough: Those who secede switch allegiance, so the whole clue both defines and builds the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To switch sides is to leave one party for its opponents, exactly what seceding does.

clue.text: He's not forced to be a soldier

definitions.text: He's not forced to be a soldier

parts.words: He's not forced to be a soldier
parts.note: describes someone who joins the army by choice rather than by conscription

explanation.definitionFit: A volunteer offers service freely, especially one who enlists without being drafted.

clue.text: Ordinary members seen at chessboard

definitions.meaning: the ordinary members of an organisation, not its leaders
a chessboard is laid out in horizontal ranks and vertical files

explanation.definitionFit: The common membership is called the rank and file, and chessboard rows and columns are ranks and files.

clue.text: For play, recasts her?

indicators.note: putting a word in for a play means rearranging, as letters are cast in new roles

explanation.surface: A director recasts a woman's part for the play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For play' signals the rearrangement of RECASTS, and 'her' points to the person who takes the part.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who performs in plays is an actress, the person a recast part goes to.

clue.text: Hit by hand in three directions

indicators.note: in tells us the hand word sits inside the compass letters

parts.note: S, E and N are the compass points south, east and north
mitt is slang for a hand

explanation.surface: Someone was struck by a hand coming from three sides.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hit' reads as a blow, but it is the past participle of 'smite'; the three compass letters are split around the hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Smitten is the past participle of smite, to strike hard; it also means lovestruck.

clue.text: Keep chattering in African country

parts.note: gab is idle chatter
on means continuing, as in to keep on doing something

explanation.surface: People in an African country never stop talking.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'keep chattering' as 'gab on': GAB, then ON.
explanation.definitionFit: Gabon is a nation on the west coast of central Africa.

clue.text: Real bacon available from this city

indicators.note: available here hints the letters of real bacon can be made into something else

explanation.surface: Proper bacon can be bought from this city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Real' hints at Real Madrid, a decoy from Spain's other big football city.
explanation.definitionFit: Barcelona is the Catalan capital and Spain's second city.

clue.text: Significance is clear, even when wrong

indicators.note: wrong suggests the letters of clear and even are set out incorrectly, so they must be rearranged

explanation.surface: The importance is plain, even when something has gone wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when wrong' signals the anagram of CLEAR and EVEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Relevance is the bearing or importance something has on a matter.

clue.text: Commander first capturing sect's diabolist

indicators.note: capturing means the commander-and-first letters hold the sect word inside them

parts.note: OC stands for officer commanding
1st is written with I standing for the digit 1
a cult is a sect

explanation.surface: A commander is the first to catch a member of a sect who worships the devil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' is written 1ST, with the digit read as the letter I; 'capturing' puts the sect inside the commander-plus-first pair.
explanation.definitionFit: A diabolist practises devil worship, one form of occult practice.

clue.text: Dispatch spring flower

parts.note: dispatch means speed, haste
a spring is a well, a source of water

explanation.surface: Send off a flower that blooms in spring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' looks like the flower's season but supplies WELL.
explanation.definitionFit: Speedwell is a small blue-flowered plant of the genus Veronica.

clue.text: Scorns note on fairground attractions

annotationWithheld.why: Scorns note on fairground attractions (7): DE + RIDES needs two letters from 'note', which gives one (D or E); no parse found, and a search for the clue gave nothing.

clue.text: Cut up, having gambled

definitions.meaning: chopped into small cubes, as vegetables are

explanation.definitionFit: Cooks cut food into small cubes, and to dice with something is to take a gamble.

clue.text: Fan's expression of desire to jump into river

indicators.note: jump into means the expression word leaps inside the river word

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales, England and Scotland
a vote expresses a preference

explanation.surface: A fan says how much they long to leap into the river.
explanation.walkthrough: VOTE goes inside DEE; the 's of 'Fan's' stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A devotee is an enthusiast, a keen follower of something.

clue.text: In excavation, rash to shake cloth

indicators.note: In tells us the stirred rash letters go inside the excavation word

parts.note: a dig is an archaeological excavation

indicators.note: shaking the word rash jumbles its letters

explanation.surface: At an archaeological dig, it is reckless to wave a cloth around.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to shake' rearranges the rash, and 'In' puts the result inside the excavation.
explanation.definitionFit: A dishrag is a cloth for washing dishes.

clue.text: Sedate way to help

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
aid means help

explanation.surface: A calm approach is the way to be of assistance.
explanation.definitionFit: Staid and sedate both mean serious and settled in manner.

clue.text: Heard adult complain

indicators.note: heard tells us the word for adult is spoken and a word of like sound is entered

parts.note: a grown person is an adult

explanation.surface: Someone overheard a grown-up moaning.
explanation.definitionFit: To groan is to moan or grumble about something.

clue.text: Composer's oral test-extremely loud one

parts.note: a viva is an oral examination at university

indicators.note: extremely means take the extremities, the first and last letters, of the word loud

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A composer's spoken exam was performed very loudly by one person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' gives L and D, the first and last letters of 'loud'; the 's of 'Composer's' stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Antonio Vivaldi was a Venetian Baroque composer, best known for The Four Seasons.

clue.text: Resign when bank of seats collapsed?

parts.note: a stand is a tiered bank of seats at a sports ground
something collapsed has fallen down

explanation.surface: A club official quits after a grandstand at the ground caves in.
explanation.definitionFit: To stand down is to withdraw from a post, to step aside.

clue.text: Counterpart to East wind

parts.note: a twin is a matching counterpart

explanation.surface: An east wind meets its opposite number.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wind' looks like a breeze, but it is the verb, rhyming with 'find'.
explanation.definitionFit: To twine is to twist or coil one thing around another.

clue.text: Dig up the east of Paris, showing no bias

parts.note: to disinter is to exhume, to unearth
est is the French word for east

explanation.surface: Excavating the eastern part of Paris without favouring anyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Disinterest in its strict sense means impartiality, having no stake in the outcome.
